nb.title: Læring i praksis · E dorisk
nb.instruction: Spill over Em7–A7, én takt per akkord. Behold E som hjem og lytt etter C♯, den store seksten. 90 BPM · 4/4 · fire takter.
nb.start: Jam åpnes ferdig innstilt. Trykk Start jam når du vil spille.

en.title: Learning in practice · E Dorian
en.instruction: Play over Em7–A7, one bar per chord. Keep E as home and listen for C♯, the major sixth. 90 BPM · 4/4 · four bars.
en.start: Jam opens with the exercise configured. Press Start jam when you are ready to play.
